mathematical_definition: Daily-resampled spread (last value per day), ranked pct within a trailing 252-day window (min_periods=60), shifted by 1 day to avoid same-day lookahead, then ffill-reindexed back onto the intraday bar timeline
numerical_stability_notes: live_compatible=false: MarketState's bounded live buffer (built in an earlier phase of this project) does not retain per-bar (or per-day) spread history -- only the current live tick's instantaneous spread, plus small tick-level ring buffers a later, different family (Task 21) will use for live spread dynamics. Unlike vol_percentile_252 (volatility_dynamics family), there is no DailyBuffer feeding a daily spread series live, so the resample('1D')+rolling(252) computation this feature needs cannot be reproduced from the live engine's bounded window. Task 21's live-tick spread family replaces it for live use (spec section 7).
missing_value_policy: NaN until at least 60 daily observations of spread are available (min_periods=60), and for any intraday bar before the first daily percentile is computed; ffill thereafter within each day
status_reason: Not a v3 survivor (research/output/v3_feature_survivors.json): catboost_importance=0.083 (<0.3), MI rank 116 (outside top 15). catboost_importance=0.0828, cv_importance=0.884, mi_rank=116, family=H_microstructure. SUMMARY.md finding #9: spread is dead weight -- zero CatBoost importance overall for the family, because spread is a constant for 98.9% of training history. research/historical_coverage.py's measure_coverage('data/gold_seed_merged_full6yr.csv') (freshly run 2026-08-19 against the real 2,456,224-row merged CSV): spread_constant_frac=0.9889492977839155. spread is present for the entire dataset (historical_coverage=FULL_HISTORY) but is degenerate (near-constant) for almost all of it, which is exactly why a 252-day percentile of it carries so little signal. Kept registered per spec section 9 -- Phase 4 may find it useful for a different target.
